description: Ministry of Defence - Amendments to the  list of Designated Persons under United Nations Regulations No. 1 of 2012
categorisation: This gazette content amends the list of designated persons under the United Nations Regulations, which constitutes a legal/regulatory matter. It involves modifying subsidiary legislation (Regulation 4(7) of the United Nations Regulations No. 1 of 2012) and updates to statutory lists of designated entities and individuals, falling squarely under legal framework and regulatory matters.
